spec_family.name: Exterior Wood Siding Repaint
spec_family.description: Condition-dependent repaint of existing exterior wood siding. Combined assess+prep+prime+finish in single mobilization. 5 substrate states drive primer selection and prep intensity. MPI Degree of Surface Degradation (DSD 0-4) is the primary cost driver — DSD-4 is a hard stop. Stacking partition separates prep modifiers (DSD, RRP) from coating modifiers (QT) to prevent compound blowout. Lead-safe RRP gate for pre-1978 buildings. Condition assessment mandatory before prep begins. Uses SF as primary UOM with siding profile modifier (lap/board_and_batten/shingle). Access type drives height modifier. 3 application methods: spray_backbrush (primary), brush_roll, brush. First repaint spec in the system — introduces substrate_condition dimension, DSD prep multiplier, RRP gate condition, and condition assessment module.

includes: Condition assessment (DSD rating, adhesion test, moisture content, existing coating ID)
Lead paint evaluation for pre-1978 buildings (EPA RRP compliance)
RRP containment setup and teardown when lead-positive
Low-pressure power wash (all substrate states)
Scraping loose/failing paint (DSD-driven intensity: light/moderate/heavy)
Feather sanding scraped edges
Chalk remediation (light or heavy per DSD)
Weathered wood sanding and brightening
Caulk joint assessment and replacement (siding-to-trim, siding-to-window, siding-to-door)
Spot prime bare areas (sound paint, mild failing)
Full prime coat (chalk-binding, acrylic stain-block, alkyd stain-block, penetrating per state)
Finish coat application (1 coat QT2, 2 coats QT3/QT4)
Interstage inspection, light sand (QT4), and touch-up
Final walkthrough inspection and touch-up
Landscape perimeter protection (LF-based)
Extended landscape overspray protection (spray method, SF-based)
Hardscape protection (walkways, patios)
Fixture and utility masking (light fixtures, HVAC units)
Vehicle/driveway overspray protection (occupied home, spray method)
Spray equipment setup and cleanup
Brush/roll equipment setup and cleanup
Site debris cleanup (includes scraping debris collection)

excludes.route_to: Window spec — window/door protection owned by surface spec

excludes.route_to: Door spec — window/door protection owned by surface spec

excludes.item: Exterior trim painting (corner boards, frieze, rake, window/door casing)

excludes.route_to: Carpentry/contractor — SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE (DSD-4) is a HARD STOP

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling coat count, inspection scrutiny, interstage sanding, and defect tolerance.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2=economy (single finish coat, minimal inspection, appropriate only for sound_paint or chalking with SC_SOUND/SC_SLIGHT). QT3=standard (2 finish coats, scan-level inspection). QT4=premium (2 finish coats, interstage sand, systematic inspection). QT5 excluded for siding field.

configuration_dimensions.description: Existing coating condition state. Primary configuration dimension for repaint — drives primer selection, prep task activation, and round configuration.
configuration_dimensions.notes: 5 repaint-specific states. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT = minimal prep. SS_EXT_CHALKING = chalk-binding primer mandatory. SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT = DSD-driven scraping + spot or full prime. SS_EXT_PEELING = extensive scraping + full prime. SS_EXT_WEATHERED = fully bare wood, penetrating primer. Per-elevation if conditions differ.

configuration_dimensions.description: MPI Degree of Surface Degradation (DSD 0-4). Drives prep labor multiplier (FAC_WSRP_DSD). SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE is a hard stop.
configuration_dimensions.notes: DSD is the dominant cost driver for repaint prep. SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE (DSD-4) = structural damage, HARD STOP — outside painting scope, refer to carpenter. Per-elevation.

configuration_dimensions.description: Siding profile type. Drives production rate modifier (FAC_WSRP_SIDING_PROFILE) and material coverage adjustment.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Lap horizontal is baseline. Board-and-batten has ~20% more effective surface due to batten profiles. Shingle has ~50% more due to overlapping edges and complex geometry.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for prime and finish coats.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray on wood siding ALWAYS requires backbrushing for fiber penetration — no spray-only option. spray_backbrush is primary for lap/board_and_batten (2-person crew). Brush_roll for smaller areas or occupied-adjacent. Brush only for shingle/shake and detail areas.

paintable_items.name: Siding Field
paintable_items.counting_rules: Net paintable siding field area in square feet. Excludes window/door openings, trim boards. Measured per elevation.
paintable_items.notes: Primary and only paintable item. Reused from SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT. Profile modifier adjusts effective surface area for production rates and coverage.

variants.notes: Minimum viable repaint. Sound surface, no primer needed. Single finish coat. Economy tier.
Standard repaint on sound surface. Spot prime bare areas + 2 finish coats.
Premium repaint on sound surface. Spot prime + 2 finish coats + interstage sand + systematic inspection.
Standard repaint on chalking surface. Chalk-binding primer mandatory + 2 finish coats.
Standard repaint on failing paint. Spot or full prime depending on bare percentage. DSD modifier on prep tasks.
Standard repaint on peeling surface. Aggressive scraping + full prime (acrylic or alkyd by wood chemistry).
Standard repaint on weathered bare wood. Sand + wood brightener + penetrating primer + 2 finish coats.
Standard brush/roll repaint on failing paint. Reduced protection — no full landscape, patio, or vehicle cover.
Standard brush/roll on sound surface. Spot prime + 2 finish coats. Minimal protection.
Standard spray on board-and-batten chalking surface. 1.20x profile modifier on all tasks.
Standard spray on peeling shingle siding. 1.50x profile modifier. Most labor-intensive non-RRP variant.
Standard brush-only on failing shingle. Most labor-intensive application method on complex profile.
Standard repaint with RRP containment. Pre-1978 + lead-positive. Adds containment setup/teardown tasks and RRP modifier on all prep tasks.
Premium repaint with RRP on peeling surface. Most expensive common variant. DSD + access + RRP stack on prep.
Premium repaint on weathered bare wood. Penetrating primer + premium finish. Interstage sand + systematic inspection.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Access type per elevation (ground/ladder/scaffold/lift) — drives FAC_EXT_ACCESS height modifier
Existing coating condition state (SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT / SS_EXT_CHALKING / SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT / SS_EXT_PEELING / SS_EXT_WEATHERED) — primary configuration dimension
MPI Degree of Surface Degradation (SC_SOUND through SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE) — drives FAC_WSRP_DSD prep multiplier
Siding profile type (lap_horizontal / board_and_batten / shingle) — drives FAC_WSRP_SIDING_PROFILE modifier
Boolean flag for pre-1978 building — triggers EPA Lead-Safe RRP requirements

protection_zones_required.notes: LF-based — measured along house perimeter where landscape is adjacent. Brush/roll: drop cloth at base. Spray: full tarp width over plantings.
Extended overspray zone beyond perimeter. Spray only.
Walkways adjacent to siding. Canvas drop cloths for non-slip crew traffic.
Patio adjacent to siding. Protection level driven by proximity and application method.
All exterior fixtures on working elevations. Bag or tape over fixture.
HVAC condenser units adjacent to siding. Full tarp cover during spray operations.
Repaint-specific — occupied home. Vehicles and driveway surface require overspray protection during spray application.
EPA RRP Rule (40 CFR 745). 6-mil poly ground containment extending 10 ft from structure. Required when disturbing lead paint on pre-1978 structures. Separate setup/teardown tasks.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Soffit at eave line. Different color typically. Separate scope.
Frieze board at siding-to-soffit junction. Trim color. Separate scope.
Corner boards frame siding. Trim color. Siding terminates at corner.
Window casing. Siding terminates at casing. Window/door protection is window/door spec's responsibility.
Door casing. Same as window casing relationship.
Foundation below siding. Not painted in siding scope.

valid_input_states.notes: 5 repaint-specific exterior wood substrate states. SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD excluded (NC domain). Stain states (SS_EXT_STAINED_SOLID, SS_EXT_STAINED_SEMI) excluded per KD-014 — requires separate stain conversion spec.

output_state.notes: All repaint input states converge to painted output state. Sheen determines specific output state.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: All tasks performed at elevation (see FAC_EXT_ACCESS applies_to list in production.json)
site_condition_rules.effect: ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50. Applied as time multiplier: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier.
site_condition_rules.notes: Access type is a height modifier, NOT a site condition. Applied per elevation. Protection setup/teardown, equipment setup/cleanup, and fixed assessment tasks are NOT affected.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: Prep tasks only (scrape, sand, chalk remediation, dust cleanup, caulk)
site_condition_rules.effect: SC_SOUND=1.00, SC_SLIGHT=1.15, SC_MODERATE=1.40, SC_SEVERE=1.75. Applied as time multiplier: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier.
site_condition_rules.notes: DSD is the dominant cost driver for repaint prep. Does NOT apply to coating tasks (prime, finish). Stacking pool: PREP_ONLY.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: Prep tasks involving paint disturbance (scrape, sand, power wash)
site_condition_rules.effect: no_rrp=1.00, rrp_required=2.00. Binary gate: either RRP applies or it does not.
site_condition_rules.notes: Gate condition — not a continuous modifier. Pre-1978 + lead-positive triggers RRP. Doubles prep task duration due to wet scraping, HEPA vacuum, containment maintenance. Stacking pool: PREP_ONLY.

stacking_partition.description: Modifiers are split into two non-overlapping pools to prevent compound blowout. Prep and coating tasks never share all modifiers.

prep_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (FAC_WSRP_DSD x FAC_EXT_ACCESS x FAC_WSRP_SIDING_PROFILE x FAC_WSRP_RRP)
prep_tasks.notes: FAC_WSRP_QT does NOT apply to prep tasks. Prep labor is condition-driven, not quality-driven. 8.40x with RRP is expected for severe exterior repaint with lead.

coating_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (FAC_WSRP_SIDING_PROFILE x FAC_EXT_ACCESS x FAC_WSRP_QT)
coating_tasks.notes: FAC_WSRP_DSD and FAC_WSRP_RRP do NOT apply to coating tasks. Once prepped, surface is at baseline. Max 2.76x — well within 4.0x cap.

fixed_tasks.notes: Assessment, equipment setup, and equipment cleaning are fixed-time tasks. No modifiers applied.

maintenance_cycles.description: Expected repaint intervals for exterior wood siding by quality tier, assuming proper prep and application.

cycles.notes: Economy single-coat repaint. Acceptable for rental/turnover properties.
Standard 2-coat repaint. Most common residential scenario.
Premium 2-coat repaint with superior materials. Longest maintenance cycle.

maintenance_cycles.routine_maintenance_definition: Annual inspection, caulk repair, spot touch-up of minor damage. Adds ~5 years to repaint interval at all tiers.

hard_stops.description: Soft, punky, or structurally compromised wood. Cannot be painted. Requires replacement by carpenter/contractor before painting scope can proceed.
hard_stops.notes: Engine must prevent estimation when SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE is selected. Entire elevation is rejected — not partial.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup → Assess → Prep → Prime → Finish 1 → Interstage → Finish 2 → Final Inspect → Cleanup
sequencing_notes.edge_work: No edge work in this spec. Siding terminates at trim boards — no cut-in or blending across specs.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Landscape/hardscape protection → Fixture masking → RRP containment (if applicable) → Equipment setup → Coating work → Protection teardown → RRP containment teardown → Equipment cleanup → Site cleanup
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Assess (mandatory first) → Prep (substrate-state + DSD-driven) → Caulk (as needed) → Prime (spot or full per state) → Finish coat 1 → Interstage (inspect, sand QT4, touch up) → Finish coat 2 (QT3/QT4) → Final inspect → Touch up
sequencing_notes.elevation_strategy: Work one elevation at a time to minimize protection setup/teardown cycles. Follow shade for optimal conditions. Per-elevation DSD rating allows mixed-condition estimation.
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO spray-only on wood siding (backbrush required). NO painting over DSD-4 (hard stop). NO RRP shortcuts (EPA 40 CFR 745 compliance mandatory).

relationships.cross_spec_protection_note: Window/door protection during siding work is owned by window/door specs, not this spec. If windows/doors are in scope, their specs handle glass/hardware masking.
relationships.notes: First repaint spec in the system. Shares ITM_SIDING_FIELD with NC sibling. Key departures from NC: substrate_condition dimension, DSD prep multiplier, RRP gate, condition assessment module, stacking partition, 5 primer paths (vs NC's 3), caulk replacement module.

sections_used: NOT used as estimation modifiers (RC-003 from PaintFactor OS)

research_corrections.original_claim: Environmental conditions (wind, dew point, sun, surface temp) should be estimation modifiers
research_corrections.corrected_to: Environmental conditions are NOT estimatable — unpredictable at bid time. Excluded from spec entirely.

research_corrections.original_claim: Stain states (solid/semi-transparent) included in repaint scope
research_corrections.corrected_to: Stain states excluded per KD-014. Stain-over-paint conversion requires separate spec with different materials and techniques.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior wood siding repaint. FIRST REPAINT SPEC — introduces substrate_condition (DSD), RRP gate, condition assessment module, stacking partition, and maintenance cycles. Key features: combined assess+prep+prime+finish (single mobilization), 5 substrate states, 5 substrate conditions (DSD 0-4, DSD-4=hard stop), 3 quality tiers (QT2-QT4), 3 siding profiles, 3 application methods, 47 tasks across 11 modules (43 binary + 4 qt_scaled), 8 material systems (5 primer + 3 finish), 5 factor modifiers (DSD/access/profile/QT/RRP) with stacking partition, 7 round configurations, 8 protection zones (including RRP containment and vehicle/driveway), 21 consumables (including 6 RRP-conditional), 14 compatibility rules, 15 variants, 15 PaintScope inputs (4 new repaint-specific). Modifier stacking: prep max 8.40x with RRP (expected for severe conditions), coating max 2.76x (within 4.0x cap).
